images.name: bedrock
images.prompt: Original production pixel-art material for Whistle Ranch, warm bright rustic overhead farm game. Reference is ONLY for palette, perspective and pixel density, not layout or copying. Crisp chunky pixel clusters, limited 12-18 color palette, directional upper-left light. No lettering, no UI, no frames, no grid, no characters, no recognizable borrowed game artwork. Create a full-bleed seamless repeatable surface texture of ONE massive continuous GREY / GREY-BROWN bedrock slab viewed from above. Not cobblestone paving, NOT individual square blocks or separate boulders, NOT white limestone. Broad heavy irregular rock facets with long intermittent fissures spanning multiple future game cells, quiet areas between fractures, moderate relief shading but no cast shadow. Irregular plates roughly 70-120 logical pixels across when output reduced to384x336. Texture covers all pixels. Macro texture for 8x8 cells, texture detail should be sparse and readable. Aspect ratio8:7, target logical384x336. Match game reference without its pale square tile appearance.
